baseline_models.focus_anchor: The agentive plural للمكذبين, under the adverse allocation ويل ... لـ, anchors the line in active takdhib rather than an accidental false statement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus construction assigns a day-indexed adverse outcome to agents who declare a report, thing, or speaker false.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something or someone false supplies the active relational act that defines the addressed class.

changed_reading.before: A general threat concerning people associated with lying.
changed_reading.after: A day-indexed adverse verdict allocated specifically to agents who actively pronounce something or someone false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same participial plural للمكذبين remains anchored in the focus root ك ذ ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The falsehood-against-truth branch broadens the class from speakers of isolated lies to people whose speech or action maintains a contrary-to-truth stance.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the governing contrast and includes both speech and action in the stance.

changed_reading.before: The condemned group merely says something untrue.
changed_reading.after: The condemned group is constituted by an enacted as well as spoken opposition to truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus participle للمكذبين can carry an exploratory pressure from the ك ذ ب branch in which a charge proves true by being carried through or false by failing.
baseline_models.mechanism: On this branch, the named stance is not only a proposition but an attempted charge whose truth is tested by whether it can be sustained through execution; ويل marks its exposure as failed.

activation_trace.role: The image of a charge fulfilled or failed supplies a performance test for the deniers' stance.

changed_reading.after: Takdhib may also name a stance or charge that fails to prove true when put through to its outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus line recurs as a whole-surah checkpoint, while تكذبون in 77:29 turns the nominal class back into an ongoing act directed at ما. The focus verdict therefore carries both serial recurrence and an encountered object of denial.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood anchors the focus label as a relational act.
The same declaring-false image in an earlier identical refrain makes 77:24 one return in a serial verdict.
The finite act of declaring false attaches the recurring agent label to the thing the agents are commanded to encounter.

structural_cues: The first post-focus refrain at 77:28 is immediately followed by the direct-object construction in 77:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition and a later finite verb with an object; I infer that the object relation feeds back into the nominal refrain and that each return accumulates prior evidence. A live alternative is that every refrain closes only its nearest block.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained curse on a fixed class of deniers.
changed_reading.after: A recurring adjudicative checkpoint that repeatedly re-identifies agents by what they keep declaring false and eventually must encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: A reminder is cast as excuse or warning near the opening, but later permission and successful excuse are unavailable. The focus verdict thus reads as liability after advance notice rather than punishment for an unnotified mistake.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the supplied message false anchors the liability in the focus participle.
A reminder that actively reminds supplies prior notice rather than merely stored information.
The excuse branch supplies the possibility of exculpation at the message-giving stage.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the preventive function of the notice.
Withheld authorization closes the later procedural opportunity to speak in defense.
The attempted-excuse image returns at judgment and shows the earlier possibility no longer operating.

structural_cues: 77:5-6 couples cast reminder with excuse or warning.
77:35-36 couples inability to speak with absence of permission to excuse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening notice function and a later barred excuse; I infer a procedural arrow from adequate warning to exhausted excuse. A live alternative is a rhetorical contrast between two scenes without a formal legal sequence.

changed_reading.after: Woe is a verdict on active denial after reminder and warning have already made excuse available, then exhausted it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threatened promise is said to fall and become fixed, messengers are assigned a time, the named day separates truth from falsehood, and dispersed generations are gathered. يومئذ in the focus becomes the execution point of a scheduled sorting process.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood against truth supplies the opposition that the scheduled process will expose.
The threatening side of promise supplies the announced adverse outcome.
Falling and becoming fixed converts announcement into eventive realization.
Fixing by a time or terminal limit supplies scheduling rather than indefinite futurity.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the day's adjudicative function.
Gathering what was dispersed supplies the prerequisite assembly on which separation operates.

structural_cues: The oath sequence culminates in 77:7 with the certainty of what is promised.
77:12 asks the appointed day, 77:13 answers day of separation, and 77:38 restates that day while gathering present and former people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, realization, timing, separation, and gathering; I order them as announcement, appointment, assembly, and adjudication, with the focus refrain as verdict. A live alternative treats them as parallel descriptions rather than procedural stages.

changed_reading.before: That day is an unspecified future setting for woe.
changed_reading.after: That day is the fixed execution point at which the announced event gathers agents and separates their false attribution from truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the addressees are brought into being from reproductive fluid, placed in a stable and empowered repository, held to a known measure, and subjected to effective determination. Their own embodiment is already a completed measured process, so denial of the announced outcome contradicts a process they inhabit.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action anchors the contradiction in the focus label.
Bringing creation into being supplies the start of the embodied process.
Reproductive fluid in the womb supplies the materially low and dependent starting state.
Stability and settlement supply preservation through the interval.
Empowerment and effective securing make the repository function, not merely contain.
A quantity reaching its set limit supplies the bounded duration of development.
Deliberate ordering by measure supplies the intelligence and execution behind the completed sequence.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 is a tightly linked origin, placement, duration, and determination sequence.
The focus refrain follows immediately at 77:24 without an intervening topic marker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a completed measured embodiment immediately before the focus; I infer an evidentiary arrow from that experienced process to the credibility of another measured outcome. A live alternative reads the sequence as a demand for gratitude without analogy to the promised day.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject an external future claim.
changed_reading.after: The deniers enact falsehood against a measured power already displayed in their own origin, preservation, and timed emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between a stable prenatal repository and an earth described as a containing receptacle for living and dead. The warning becomes a hinge between two holdings, so denial is voiced from inside the very life-to-death containment sequence it rejects.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood against truth anchors the denial that is spatially enclosed by the two context sequences.
Stable settlement supplies the pre-focus repository.
Gathering and holding in a receptacle supplies the post-focus earth-container.
Living beings supply one population held by the earth-container.
Loss of life supplies the other population and extends containment across the transition to death.

structural_cues: 77:21 names a secure resting place before the focus; 77:25-26 names earth as a receptacle for living and dead after it.
The focus line is the sole verse between the two material containment descriptions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two receptacle constructions on opposite sides of 77:24; I infer that their placement makes the refrain a hinge across origin, life, and death. A live alternative treats the two blocks as separate demonstrations joined only by the recurring refrain.

changed_reading.before: The denial is an abstract opinion about a remote day.
changed_reading.after: The denial is uttered from within a continuous system that securely holds the deniers before birth, during life, and in death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised event is carried into fixed occurrence, judgment on criminals is described as enacted work, favorable outcome is tied to intentional work, and the commanded bodily act is refused. These performance cues strengthen the focus-root branch in which a charge becomes false by failing to be carried through.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving true or false through execution anchors the performance reading in the focus root.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies successful realization on the side of the promise.
Producing an act supplies explicit execution rather than assertion.
Intentional work supplies the human side of outcome-bearing performance.
Bodily humility is the concrete performance requested and withheld.

structural_cues: 77:7 asserts realization, 77:18 says what is done to criminals, 77:43 grounds outcome in work, and 77:48 presents an action refused.
These performance statements are distributed across the whole surah rather than confined to the focus's neighboring block.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies realized event, enacted judgment, consequential work, and refused bowing; I infer that they test competing claims by performance and activate the charge-failure branch. The live alternative remains the ordinary sense of verbal denial with action only as evidence of it.

changed_reading.before: The exploratory failed-charge branch has no test supplied by the focus alone.
changed_reading.after: The deniers' stance is exposed as the charge that fails in performance, while the promise proves true by being carried through.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence juxtaposes speech that can no longer be uttered or excused, a present command whose bodily submission is refused, and a final question about any later discourse producing heart-settled assent. Takdhib becomes a broken response chain linking received saying, embodied response, accountable speech, and belief.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a message false anchors the failure at the reception-and-response relation.
Articulate speech supplies the capacity removed at the adjudicative stage.
Excuse supplies the defensive speech that cannot repair the prior response.
Uttered saying supplies the received verbal command.
Humbling the body supplies the response that the addressees withhold.
Renewed report or discourse supplies the possibility of another communicative prompt.
Assent in which the heart settles supplies the missing endpoint of reception.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 removes speech and excuse, 77:48 pairs a spoken command with refused bodily response, and 77:50 closes with discourse and belief.
The refrain occurs between each of these late-surah response scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the speech, excuse, command, bodily response, later discourse, and belief terms; I infer a directional response chain among them. A live alternative reads them as separate symptoms of denial rather than stages of one failed reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mukadhdhibin names an intellectual or verbal position only.
changed_reading.after: Mukadhdhibin names a failed whole-person response in which saying is rejected, the body does not yield, later defense closes, and trust never settles.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the focus branch of a cloth whose appearance deceives into an environmental contrast. It remains anchored in ك ذ ب B009 and in the packet's shade that is named as cover yet neither shades nor suffices, opposed to actual protective shade. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for the deniers' false-making condition, not as a lexical gloss of للمكذبين.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus participle للمكذبين is held to the branch in which an object's displayed condition makes a false claim.

activation_trace.role: The deceptively patterned cloth supplies an appearance that promises one condition while materially delivering another.
Shade as covering supplies the apparent function promised by the named destination.
Shade as protection supplies the function explicitly negated in the punitive scene.
Sufficiency supplies the failed performance test: the apparent shelter does not avail against flame.
Warding off harm supplies the contrasting protected class for whom shade is not counterfeit.

changed_reading.before: The deniers only make false verbal assertions.
changed_reading.after: Their false-making condition is mirrored by a pseudo-shelter whose name and appearance claim cover while its material performance denies that claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus branch concerns milk that disappoints by disappearing, while the context concerns human enjoyment. It remains anchored in ك ذ ب B006 and is activated by the explicit pairing of enjoyment with little duration, contrasted with untroubled provision. Render it only as an exploratory failure-of-expectation analogy, not as the denotation of takdhib.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root is held to the branch where an expected supply proves false by failing to continue.

activation_trace.role: Milk that vanishes instead of lasting supplies the material image of disappointed reliance.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the present resource on which the addressees may rely.
Littleness supplies the explicit limit that makes the enjoyed resource fail as a lasting expectation.
Enjoyment without hardship or harmful consequence supplies the contrasting form of reliable provision.

changed_reading.before: Deniers are defined solely by propositions they reject.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also entrust themselves to a short-lived benefit that proves false as lasting provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch pictures a wild animal running a stage and then stopping to look back, whereas the context supplies repeated commands to proceed. It remains anchored in ك ذ ب B007 and receives a visible motion trigger from انطلقوا. Downstream prose should mark the stop-and-look-back sequence as reader-supplied spatial analogy, not claim that the command itself says to stop.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus participle is tested against the branch image of flight that runs for a stage and then breaks off to look behind.

activation_trace.role: Running and then stopping to look back supplies an interrupted-flight image for denial as evasion.
Unimpeded setting-out supplies the first compelled movement toward the denied object.
The repeated setting-out command turns prior evasive motion into a directed route with a destination.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is evasive motion that cannot remain free flight and is converted into a compelled approach to what was denied.

strongest_changes: The exact refrain and 77:29's finite denial turn 77:24 from an isolated curse into a serial verdict tied to an encountered object.
Reminder, warning, and later barred excuse make the verdict procedurally charged: notice precedes exhausted defense.
Promise, occurrence, timing, gathering, and separation specify يومئذ as a scheduled adjudicative process.
The immediate creation sequence and the paired womb-earth repositories make denial contradict a measured life-to-death process already enclosing the deniers.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the short focus line function as both recurring checkpoint and material hinge. It also activated performance, counterfeit shelter, failed provision, and interrupted motion branches that a local reading of ك ذ ب would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether each refrain accumulates the entire preceding surah or closes only its nearest evidentiary block.
How far the performance reading may broaden active takdhib beyond verbal attribution without overextending B004.
Whether the B006, B007, and B009 material analogies are intended pressures or only lexically licensed exploratory echoes.
